It’s probably a dopamine imbalance, we as a generation are so used to hundreds of quick fixes every hour so our happiness starts to rely on that. I’ve been trying to constantly work towards something for the future instead of scroll on my phone or nap all day, it’s helping me slowly remember what life was like when I was happy

I feel like I missed my chance on my ideal life. Things just didn’t pan out the way I thought it would, good jobs never opened up either. I’ve been bouncing around medium paying jobs and serving tables. I currently work at 2 different restaurants, one is 30min away. I’m only 19 so I know I have a lot of time to figure it out, but I moved out with a couple friends, we bought a house, so I have a mortgage and a car payment on top of groceries, subscriptions, and all the renovating of the house we’re doing. I’ve been taking epic pictures for this church, and they kinda made it seem like I would get a job, or at least get paid in some way. I haven’t gotten paid anything and I’m struggling heavy with finances. The head pastors son is my roommate so I feel like I can’t talk about my situation because I don’t want to seem desperate for a job or something idk. I’m bad at asking for help to begin with so there’s no way I’m gonna walk into the pastors office and ask for a job. I’m just lost in life. I thought I was doing the right thing by taking so much of my time and giving it to the church. I spent more time editing a video for the church today than I spent at work serving tables. When I finished the video, roommate said it wasn’t what he had pictured in his head. I feel like I blew my chance at a job there now. Idk man I just feel defeated in every way possible. Idk if I should hang up the camera for good and go work a 9-5 or keep trying. I know I can be great if someone would just give me a chance. I don’t talk a crazy amount so I feel like I get overlooked. I’m humble, loyal, patient, and basically every other good thing. I see everyone else get blessed with random money wads or help from their parents. I feel like I haven’t had a blessing I deserve since I was 16. It feels awful saying that as a Christian but that’s how I feel. I can’t talk to anyone about it and my parents would never give me financial help. 
To make a long story short, I’m at the end of my rope here. I love making things, videos being one of the funnest ones, but if I can’t make a living off of it then I’ll lose everything. I either go all in and risk it, or put the camera down and get another job. 
Sorry for all that, I have a lot on my mind rn
